verdict.rationale: Sentry documents fingerprint rules for customizing grouping (sentry-docs-14) and issue triage/status features (sentry-docs-20, sentry-docs-21), confirming custom grouping override exists, but there's no explicit documentation of the automatic stack-trace fingerprinting algorithm itself grouping thousands of duplicates, nor independent/hands-on evidence validating grouping accuracy or the customization workflow in practice. missing for 10: first-party explanation of default fingerprinting/stack-trace grouping algorithm, independent validation that grouping works well at scale, hands-on example of overriding grouping when it fails.
